source.snippet: Since LinkedIn has "revamped" their job search functionality with AI my usual place to see what jobs are available is now pretty much gone. How do you look for jobs/new opportunities? (Ask HN, 2026-09-25, 3 points)

problem_statement: LinkedIn's AI-driven job search revamp has degraded the usefulness of its search results, leaving professionals unable to efficiently discover relevant job openings and forcing them to hunt for alternative platforms.
target_segment: Mid-to-senior professionals and tech workers actively job-seeking, who previously relied on LinkedIn job search as their primary discovery tool.
notes: Buyer signal: professionals spend significant time on job hunting; some already pay for LinkedIn Premium (~$40-60/month). The complaint is about a paid-adjacent platform getting worse, implying willingness to switch to a paid alternative that delivers better signal-to-noise. Recurring theme across HN/Reddit — this Ask HN post is recent (2026-09-25) and echoes a broader pattern of LinkedIn product quality complaints. A focused job-search aggregator or alert service with clean filtering could capture these users.
